title: Alarm volume too low.
text:
Alarm volume too low.. I can't hear it unless I hold it up to my ear. Loved this timer except for the volume of the timer alarm.
I bought a replacement for this timer. I got the "HAOBAIMEI 2 PACK Digital Kitchen Timer" for less than $8. Highly recommend. https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B07CYCQCR8/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o00_s00?ie=UTF8&psc=1

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Triple Timer
features: Three 100-hour digital timers with unique alarm sounds
Useful for timing long events and sub-intervals
Easy-read LCD display functions as clock when not timing
Angled face for clear visibility on countertops or shelves
Soft buttons, non-slip feet for stability and surface protection
description: The OXO Good Grips Triple Timer lets you track three events at once or time a long event with secondary intervals. The keypad features soft, easy-press buttons. All three timers can be set up to 100 hours. Each timer has a dedicated area on the easy-to-read LCD, plus a unique alarm sound. To set a timer, press the corresponding button (t1, t2, t3). The LCD automatically converts to clock mode when a timer is not in use. The angled face is easy to see when placed on a countertop or shelf, and the non-slip bottom provides stability while also protecting surfaces. Two AAA batteries included.
